title: Captive Singhs Are Sent to Lahore

blocks.text: Then large Turkish forces advanced, seized many Singhs, and sent the captives onward to Lahore to be killed. (41)
Seeing only a few, the Singhs still fought; seeing many more, they gathered themselves together and struck harder. (42)
From that time open hostility between Singhs and Turks grew greater, while faithless Hindus too joined in opposition to the Panth. (43)
